<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  One choice as a radio group drawn as chips: a fieldset with role radiogroup named by its legend, one radio per
  option (the first checked), the name and an optional price or note. Static markup.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { DishOption } from "./option-chips.types";

  export type OptionChipsProps = {
    name: string;
    legend: string;
    options: DishOption[];
    extra?: "none" | "price" | "note";
    layout?: "wrap" | "column";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Fieldset from "../compose/Fieldset.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import Label from "../compose/Label.svelte";
  import Legend from "../compose/Legend.svelte";
  import Radio from "../compose/Radio.svelte";
  import { cn, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let { name, legend, options, extra = "none", layout = "wrap" }: OptionChipsProps = $props();
</script>

<Fieldset
  class="flex flex-col gap-2"
  role="radiogroup"
  aria-labelledby={tpl("{0}-legend", name)}
  data-slot="option-group"
>
  <Legend size="sm" class="mb-2" id={tpl("{0}-legend", name)}>
    {legend}
  </Legend>
  <Box class={(((layout as string) === "column") ? "flex flex-col gap-2" : "flex flex-wrap gap-2")}>
    {#each options as o, i (o.id)}
      <Label
        class={cn(
          "flex items-center gap-2 rounded px-4 py-2 text-sm inset-ring inset-ring-border has-checked:bg-muted " +
            "has-checked:inset-ring-foreground",
          (((layout as string) === "column") ? "justify-between" : "")
        )}
        data-slot="option"
      >
        <Inline class="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Radio name={name} value={o.id} checked={(i === 0)} />
          <Inline>
            {o.name}
          </Inline>
        </Inline>
        {#if ((extra as string) === "price")}
          <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
            {fmtMoney(o.price, o.currency)}
          </Inline>
        {/if}
        {#if ((extra as string) === "note")}
          <Inline class="text-muted-foreground">
            {o.note}
          </Inline>
        {/if}
      </Label>
    {/each}
  </Box>
</Fieldset>
